text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear prioritization. Start by listing all your tasks and deciding which ones are most important. Focus on these first, because not everything needs the same amount of effort. Scope management is also key: if a task is too big, break it into smaller parts or agree to remove less important details. Finally, communication matters. If you think you might miss a deadline, tell your manager, teacher, or team early. They can often help you adjust the plan. With planning and honest communication, deadlines become much easier to handle.
